Striking numbers only. Every figure links to its issuer. Full status and wording live on [Official status](tracker.qmd); diagrams on [Glossary](glossary.qmd); dates on [Timeline](dates.qmd).

```{=html}
<style>
.kfig{--ink:#1a1a1a;--navy:#003366;--beige:#F7F6F3;--line:#d9d4c7;--gold:#C5A572;--muted:#5f5f5f;margin:1rem 0 1.4rem}
.kfig-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.55rem}
@media (min-width:640px){.kfig-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kfig-card{background:var(--beige);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:3px solid var(--navy);border-radius:8px;padding:.7rem .85rem 0.85rem;line-height:1.35}
.kfig-card .num{display:block;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-0.02em;margin:0.1rem 0 0.35rem}
.kfig-card .label{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink)}
.kfig-card .src{display:block;margin-top:.45rem;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
.kfig-card .src a{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.kfig-card.wide{grid-column:1 / -1}
.kfig-card.gold{border-top-color:var(--gold)}
</style>
```

## Height and airspace

```{=html}
<div class="kfig"><div class="kfig-grid">
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">~1,000 m</span><span class="label">Hong Kong working description of LAE — economic activities in airspace generally below about 1,000 metres (not a Cap. 448G flying limit).</span><span class="src">Issuer: LegCo paper <a href="https://www.legco.gov.hk/yr2024/english/panels/edev/papers/edev20241203cb3-933-3-e.pdf">CB(3)933/2024</a> · also on <a href="tracker.qmd">Official status</a></span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">120 m / 300 m</span><span class="label">Mainland airspace labels (真高): 120 m controlled airspace; 300 m fused flight — different scheme from Hong Kong’s 1,000 m working description.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202306/content_6888800.htm">国令761</a> Arts. 19 &amp; 22 · Glossary altitude diagram</span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">100 ft / 300 ft</span><span class="label">Hong Kong Cap. 448G operating height limits for Category A1 (100 ft AGL) and Category A2 (300 ft AGL ≈ 91 m). Higher needs CAD permission.</span><span class="src">Issuer: CAD <a href="https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.1276_E.pdf">G.N. 1276 of 2022</a> · Glossary</span></div>
</div></div>
```

## Cap. 448G weight bands

```{=html}
<div class="kfig"><div class="kfig-grid">
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">≤ 150 kg</span><span class="label">Small unmanned aircraft (SUA) ceiling under Cap. 448G — the main Hong Kong legal label for light unmanned craft.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G">Cap. 448G</a> · Official status</span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">A1 → C</span><span class="label">Weight classes: A1 ≤250 g; A2 ≤7 kg; B ≤25 kg; C above 25 kg up to 150 kg (Category C from 18 Jul 2025).</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G">Cap. 448G</a>; Cat C start <a href="https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/17/P2025071700590.htm">GIA, 17 Jul 2025</a></span></div>
</div></div>
```

## Trial programmes (two separate counts)

```{=html}
<div class="kfig"><div class="kfig-grid">
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">38 of 72</span><span class="label">First Regulatory Sandbox — first batch of pilot projects selected from applications.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm">GIA, 20 Mar 2025</a> · Official status</span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">33</span><span class="label">Sandbox X selected modules so far: UTM 15 + unconventional aircraft 4 + shared platform 5 + others 9 (15+4+5+9). Separate from the Sandbox 38.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.tlb.gov.hk/eng/highlights/transport/low-altitude.html">TLB Low-altitude page</a> · Official status</span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">&gt;140</span><span class="label">Regularised Regulatory Sandbox projects approved (Policy Address figure) — not the same as the first-batch 38.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/en/chapter3.html">2026 Policy Address ¶137</a></span></div>
<div class="kfig-card"><span class="num">~10</span><span class="label">Sandbox X projects that had begun testing (Policy Address snapshot) — not the same as the 33 module total.</span><span class="src">Issuer: <a href="https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/en/chapter3.html">2026 Policy Address ¶137</a></span></div>
</div></div>
```
